basic_info.description: Step back in time and experience the enduring appeal of mid-century modern architecture with this original gem! This well maintained 2 bedroom 1 Bath offers the beautifully custom crafted details only offered in San Francisco homes! This home is light and bright w/beautiful hardwood floors, newly painted exterior and updated appliances in the kitchen.  This timeless beauty exudes character and offers a unique opportunity for those seeking the highly sought after neighborhood of Twin Peaks and a property with vintage elegance and unlimited potential! This home features the authentic details of its era, including original hardwood floors,spacious living area, w/large windows flooding the rooms w/natural light! The layout creates a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for both entertaining and everyday living! The kitchen retains its charming vintage appeal, ready for your personal updates or enhancements. On a clear day you can see the partial ocean views! This floor plan has endless opportunities!  Don't miss the rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco's architectural history! Located conveniently to shopping, transportation, top restaurants and minutes to the ocean,this home is a must see!  The added potential square footage of the basement screams "Finish me!!!"
